recommended_steps: Identify the blown fuse by checking for a white mark in the fuse window.
Remove the cause of the failure (e.g., short-circuiting of a cable connected to a load).
Replace the blown fuse with a new one of the same rating.
required_tools: Not specified in available manual data
required_parts: Replacement fuse for F1 or F2 (exact type not specified in manual data)
